content: For tuning our model, we explore the dimensionality of word vector and LSTM hidden state vectors of discourse arguments of 25, 50, 100, and 200 as pretrained GLOVE vectors were trained in this setting. For optimization, we used Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) and Adam BIBREF23 with learning rates 0.01 and 0.001.
